questions.question:
Arrange the following words in a logical sequence as they would appear in the English dictionary.

1. Jacklight

2. Jacket

3. Jade

4. Joker

5. Jampacked
questions.solution:
The correct sequence according to English dictionary is

2. **Jacke**t

1. **Jackl**ight

3. **Jad**e

5. **Jam**packed

4. **Jo**ker

Hence, the correct sequence is 2, 1, 3, 5, 4.

questions.question: If it was a Sunday on 1 January 2017, what was the day of the week on 31 December 2017?
questions.solution:
Code for the days:

 
 

 
 
Code of the day

 
 
 
Day

 
 
 

 
 
0

 
 
 
Sunday

 
 
 

 
 
1

 
 
 
Monday

 
 
 

 
 
2

 
 
 
Tuesday

 
 
 

 
 
3

 
 
 
Wednesday

 
 
 

 
 
4

 
 
 
Thursday

 
 
 

 
 
5

 
 
 
Friday

 
 
 

 
 
6

 
 
 
Saturday

 
 
 

 

Given,

1 January 2017 is Sunday.

1 January 2017 (Sunday) + **364 days** (Because 2017 is not a leap year) = 31 December 2017.

**364 Days** = **0 odd days**.

So, 1 January 2017 (Sunday) + 364 days (0 odd days) = Sunday.

Therefore, 31 December 2017 = Sunday.

hence, the correct answer is "Sunday".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Year - One year has 365 days or 366 days on this basis the year is divided into two parts:

 
• Normal year - It has 365 days.
 
• Leap year - It has 366 days and is completely divisible by 4.

Century leap year - The year which is exactly divisible by 400. Example - 1200, 1600, 2000 etc.

Counting of Odd days

Ordinary Year: 365 days (52 weeks + 1 days)

= 1 Odd days

Leap Year: 366 days (52 weeks + 2 days)

= 2 Odd days

questions.question:
Select the number-pair in which the two numbers are related in the same way as are the two

numbers of the following number-pair.

8 : 72
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

8 : 72 → 8 × 9 = 72

Similarly,

11 : 132 → 11 × 12 = 132

Hence, 11 : 132 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming

the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts,

decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All hens are eggs.

No birds are eggs.

All eggs are lions.

**Conclusions:**

I. All hens are lions.

II. Some lions are hens.

III. No eggs are birds.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
Either conclusion II or III follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8612393c33053688890ea1820d2fec173fc6b757b2f2ca0625590c662c622639.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. All hens are lions → True (All hens are eggs and all eggs are lions)

II. Some lions are hens → True (All hens are eggs and all eggs are lions)

III. No eggs are birds → True. (No birds are eggs.)

Hence, all the conclusions follow.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

35 + 7 - 5 × 2 ÷ 25 = 20
questions.solution:
35 + 7 - 5 × 2 ÷ 25 = 20

After interchanging + and ÷

35 ÷ 7 - 5 × 2 + 25 (according to BODMAS rule)

= 5 - 5 × 2 + 25

= 5 – 10 +25

= 30 - 10

= 20

Hence, the correct answer is '+ and ÷'.

questions.question: If EAST is coded as 180 and NORTH is coded as 375, then how will SOUTH be coded as?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f8301e0e8e4527b4068d88f39c023c422c2d7237bc5e44bc5fc369291cb6009.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

(Number of letters) × (Sum of the positional value of all the letters in the word)

EAST = 5 + 1 + 19 + 20 = 45 and 45 × 4 = 180

NORTH = 14 + 15 + 18 + 20 + 8 = 75 and 75 × 5 = 375

Similarly,

SOUTH = 19 + 15 + 21 + 20 + 8 = 83 and 83 × 5 = 415

Hence, the correct answer is 415.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the

following set.

(15, 49, 151)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

(15, 49, 151) → 15 × 3 + 4 = 49 and 49 × 3 + 4 = 151

Similarly,

(5, 19, 61) → 5 × 3 + 4 = 19 and 19 × 3 + 4 = 61

Hence, the correct answer is (5, 19, 61).

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the

questions.solution:

Similarly,

10 × 4 = 40 and 40 × 5 = 200

Hence, the correct answer is (10, 40, 200).
